full_prompt_en: A square realistic painting shows an old house beyond a broad moonlit snowfield, framed by leafless birch trees under a dark winter sky. The snow occupies the lower third and is almost white near the center, with cool blue-gray shadows crossing it. At the lower left, the field stretches uninterrupted toward a dark wooded boundary. Near the center-left, a tall white birch trunk rises from the snow and branches into a delicate network across the upper half. Its black bark patches and pale limbs are sharply visible against the slate-blue sky. A small luminous moon hangs to the left of the trunk in the upper middle, softened by a faint halo. The house stands just right of center and extends off the right edge. Its tall stone front has a steep dark roof with scattered snow along the shingles, and a lower porch projects to the left. Several narrow windows puncture the pale stone, while a warm amber window glows on the darker side wall near the lower right. A short set of steps leads from the porch to the snowy ground. More thin birch trunks stand immediately to the right of the house and cast narrow shadows toward the foreground. Behind the house, a dense belt of nearly black winter trees forms a horizontal line and separates the building from the sky. The foreground snow is not blank: small ridges, twigs, and fine tracks show beneath blue tree shadows. The longest shadow begins at the large birch base and widens toward the bottom center, with thinner branch shadows spreading outward like veins. Fine, controlled paint texture describes the stonework, bare branches, roof shingles, and powdery snow without flattening them into one surface. Cool moonlight from the upper left illuminates the front wall and field; the small amber window supplies a separate warm note inside the otherwise cold scene. The overall composition is still and spacious, balancing the vertical birch and house against a wide quiet snow plane and a deep gray-blue night.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形写实绘画呈现一栋旧房子立在宽阔月光雪地之后，落叶白桦树与深色冬夜天空将其框住。积雪占据下方三分之一，中部近乎纯白，冷蓝灰色阴影横过其上。左下方，雪野不间断地延向深色林缘。中左附近，一根高大的白桦树干从雪里升起，在上半幅分成细密枝网。黑色树皮斑块与浅色树枝在石板蓝天空前清楚可见。一轮发亮的小月亮挂在树干左侧的中上方，外有淡淡光晕。房屋立在中央偏右并延伸出右边缘。高高的石砌正面有陡峭深色屋顶，瓦片上零散积雪，较低门廊向左突出。几扇窄窗穿过浅色石墙，较暗的侧墙在右下附近亮着一扇暖琥珀色窗。一小段台阶从门廊通向雪地。更多纤细白桦紧贴房屋右侧，向前景投下狭窄阴影。房后，一道近黑色冬树林形成水平线，将建筑与天空分开。前景积雪并非空白：小雪脊、树枝和细痕在蓝色树影下可见。最长的影子从大白桦树根开始，向下方中央变宽，较细枝影像叶脉一样向外伸展。细致受控的绘画肌理区分石墙、裸枝、屋瓦和粉状雪，不把它们压成同一表面。左上方冷月光照亮正墙与雪地；小小的琥珀色窗为其余冷调场景提供独立暖色重音。整体构图静止而宽敞，以竖立的白桦和房屋平衡宽阔安静的雪面与深灰蓝夜色。
style_prompt_en: The realistic painting uses precise surface detail within a quiet, low-saturation nocturnal palette. Slate blue, charcoal, cool white, and weathered gray dominate, interrupted by a very small amber glow. Thin branching lines and solid vertical masses rise against broad open planes, creating a clear contrast of scale. Directional cool light from an upper side produces long blue-gray shadows over pale surfaces, while recesses remain dark and dense. Fine brushwork differentiates powdery, stony, fibrous, and weathered textures without making the scene busy. Distant forms compress into a dark horizontal band, so the nearest open area feels especially spacious. The overall effect is hushed and contemplative, with exact light placement and restrained warm-cool contrast giving the stillness its force.
style_prompt_zh: 这种写实绘画在安静的低饱和夜色中保留精确表面细节。石板蓝、炭黑、冷白与风化灰占主导，仅有一小处琥珀色光打断。纤细分枝线和坚实竖向体块从宽阔空平面前升起，形成清楚的尺度对比。来自一侧上方的冷定向光在浅色表面投出长蓝灰阴影，凹处保持深暗浓密。细密笔触区分粉状、石质、纤维状与风化肌理，却不使画面繁忙。远处形体压缩成深色水平带，使最近的开放区域显得格外宽敞。整体效果静谧沉思，准确的光位与克制的暖冷对比赋予静止感力量。
theme_en: A moonlit winter house beyond a snowfield and leafless birch trees
theme_zh: 月夜雪地和落叶白桦后的一栋冬日房屋
name: Peter Sculthorpe
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
